name: Quick Sparkling Lemonade
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 7 cups (1.7 L/1.8 quarts) cold carbonated water
1 package of lemonade-flavored Kool-Aid, or similar powdered drink mix

steps: Pour the carbonated water into a 2-quart pitcher.
Add sugar and Kool-Aid or drink mix. Stir thoroughly.
Serve chilled over ice, if desired.
